name: sm-google-workspace
call: <task in plain language> (e.g. List all folders in the root of my Google Drive)
purpose: Section manager for Google Workspace: Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Docs, Calendar, Chat, Contacts, Tasks, and the rest of `gog`'s apps. It runs `gog` itself from bash, so the default call is a plain-language task in a chat turn — that chat turn is what gives it tools. `/ask` is the exception: it starts no chat turn, so it answers from the model's memory and cannot reach Google; use it only for text work. For two frequent questions, `/gdrive-root` and `/inbox-new` run `gog` directly with no model turn and no tokens.

commands.name: /gdrive-root
commands.description: Root of Google Drive: name, folder|file, id, modified — one tab-separated row per item. No model turn, no tokens.

commands.name: /inbox-new
commands.description: Unread mail newer than N hours (default 24): date, from, subject, id. No model turn, no tokens.

commands.name: /ask
commands.description: One request, no chat turn: /ask "question" [--model gpt-6.1-sol] [--effort low] [--timeout 60]. Save defaults with --set-default-model.
